verdict.rationale: Jitsu's Profile Builder creates customer profiles from event traits and supports custom JS logic over up to a year of event history, which could theoretically compute traits like recency/frequency — but there is no evidence of built-in predictive scoring (LTV, churn, purchase propensity) or native ML models, nor any documented integration with targeting/activation destinations for such scores. missing for 10: built-in predictive scoring models (LTV/churn/propensity), documented ML/statistical scoring capability, evidence of computed scores flowing into targeting/audience activation.
